summary: Revised implementation plan for the native Android 'Dev Options Shortcut' utility app, upgraded with universal Android version compatibility from API 21 (Android 5.0 Lollipop) through API 35 (Android 15), multi-tier OEM intent fallbacks (Xiaomi MIUI/HyperOS, Samsung One UI, Huawei EMUI, AOSP), version-guarded system APIs, Material 3 dynamic and static theming, AdMob 23.+ integration with 3-tap frequency cap, and a full interactive web testing simulator with instant Android Studio project ZIP export.
